title: JRN-013 Happy Path: Trade Finance Letter of Credit — Application to Settlement
description: Full happy-path flow: Business Customer submits LC application, facility check passes, compliance screening clears, SWIFT MT700 issued, compliant documents presented and examined within 5 banking days, sight payment settled. Compliance screening (CAP-005) and SWIFT messaging (CAP-003) cross capability boundaries via async events only. Facility check and settlement debit use same-capability synchronous API (SVC-006 → SVC-005 within CAP-002).

steps.label:
POST /trade-finance/lc-applications
{business_customer_id, lc_type: sight, currency: USD, amount: 250000,
beneficiary: Shanghai Export Trading Co.,
beneficiary_country: CN, BIC: ICBKCNBJXXX,
hs_tariff_codes: [846240, 846291], incoterms: CIF,
latest_shipment: 2026-06-30, expiry: 2026-07-21}

GET /business-customers/{id}
(same-capability — validates applicant status)
200 OK {BusinessCustomer status=active}

Creates ENT-036 (LetterOfCredit)
status=application_submitted
credit_status=pending
compliance_status=not_started

EVT-075: LCApplicationSubmitted
topic: commercial.trade-finance

201 Created {lc_id, lc_reference: LCIMPORT-2026-089,
status: application_submitted}

Delivers EVT-075 → application acknowledgement
with LC reference to PER-002

GET /business-accounts/{id}
(same-capability — reads facility headroom)

200 OK {available_lc_limit: 500000 USD,
blocked_amount: 0, headroom: 500000 ≥ 250000 ✓}

LetterOfCredit.credit_status = facility_confirmed
facility_check_timestamp populated

steps.description: PH-054: Compliance Screening (CAP-002 → CAP-005 — async event only)

steps.label:
EVT-076: LCComplianceScreeningRequested [CROSS-CAPABILITY ▶]
topic: compliance.sanctions-screening
{beneficiary: Shanghai Export Trading Co.,
country: CN, BIC: ICBKCNBJXXX,
hs_codes: [846240, 846291]}

LetterOfCredit.compliance_status = screening_requested
LC suspended — awaiting EVT-077
Delivers EVT-076 [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-005]

Screens: OFSI list ✓ CLEAR
OFAC SDN ✓ CLEAR
UN consolidated list ✓ CLEAR
HS 846240/846291 export control ✓ CLEAR (non-restricted industrial machinery)
TBML typology assessment ✓ LOW risk
Delivers EVT-077 [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-002]

LetterOfCredit.compliance_status = cleared
compliance_cleared_at populated
Proceeds to PH-055

steps.description: PH-055: LC Issuance — SWIFT MT700 (CAP-002 → CAP-003 — async event only)

steps.label:
Formats LC terms per UCP 600 + SWIFT MT700 fields
LetterOfCredit.status = issued
swift_reference = LCIMPORT-2026-089
issue_date = 2026-04-15

EVT-078: LCIssued [CROSS-CAPABILITY ▶]
topic: commercial.trade-finance
{lc_reference, advising_bank_bic: ICBKCNBJXXX,
expiry: 2026-07-21, amount: USD 250000,
issuance_channel: swift_mt700}
Delivers EVT-078 [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-003]

Formats and transmits SWIFT MT700
to ICBKCNBJXXX (ICBC Shanghai)
Delivery confirmed via SWIFT ACK

Delivers EVT-078 → LC issuance confirmation to PER-002
(lc_reference, expiry date, terms summary)

steps.description: PH-056: Document Presentation (8 Jul 2026 — 13 days after BL date 25 Jun, within 21-day limit)

steps.label:
POST /trade-finance/lc-applications/{id}/presentations
{presentation_date: 2026-07-08, bl_date: 2026-06-25,
drawing_amount: 250000, channel: physical_courier,
documents: [invoice×1, BL×3, packing list×1,
insurance cert×2, cert_of_origin×1]}

Creates ENT-038 (TradeDocument)
presentation_date=2026-07-08
bl_date=2026-06-25
presentation_deadline=2026-07-21 ≤ expiry ✓
presented_on_time=true
Examination deadline = 2026-07-08 + 5 banking days = 2026-07-15

201 Created {presentation_id,
examination_deadline: 2026-07-15}

Delivers EVT-079 → Trade Finance Ops alert:
new presentation for examination by 2026-07-15

Examines:
✓ Commercial invoice: 3 originals, correct amount USD 250,000, goods match LC field 45A
✓ Bills of lading: full set 3/3, shipped on board 2026-06-25,
  consignee to order, blank endorsed, notify applicant,
  port of loading Shanghai, discharge Felixstowe
✓ Insurance cert: USD 275,000 (110% CIF), ICC(A), blank endorsed
✓ Certificate of origin: Chinese origin, authorised body
✓ Packing list: consistent with invoice
All documents: COMPLIANT

Creates ENT-039 (DocumentExamination)
examination_result=compliant
discrepancy_count=0
LetterOfCredit.status = settled (pending)

201 Created {examination_id, result: compliant,
next_action: 'Settlement proceeding'}

Delivers EVT-080 → PER-002 notified:
documents accepted, payment will follow

steps.description: PH-058: Settlement — account debit (same-capability) then SWIFT reimbursement (cross-capability)

steps.label:
POST /business-accounts/{id}/debit
{amount: 250000, currency: USD, reference: LCIMPORT-2026-089,
purpose: lc_settlement}
(same-capability — must succeed before SWIFT event)

Debits BusinessAccount (ENT-B002)
balance reduced by USD 250,000
creates debit transaction record

200 OK {debit_reference: TXN-2026-LC-089,
settlement_confirmed: true}

LetterOfCredit.status = settled
settlement_date = 2026-07-11
settlement_amount = 250000 USD
account_debit_reference = TXN-2026-LC-089

EVT-081: LCSettled [CROSS-CAPABILITY ▶]
topic: commercial.trade-finance
{settlement_amount: 250000, currency: USD,
advising_bank_bic: ICBKCNBJXXX,
account_debit_reference: TXN-2026-LC-089}
Delivers EVT-081 [◀ CROSS-CAPABILITY received by CAP-003]

Transmits SWIFT MT202
(General Financial Institution Transfer)
to ICBKCNBJXXX for USD 250,000
Delivery confirmed

Delivers EVT-081 → settlement confirmation to PER-002
(amount debited, SWIFT reference, beneficiary paid)
